gate_title: Sacrificial Calibration Pilot Difficulty & Discrimination Gate Specification

governing_laws.isolation_law: PILOT_ITEM != INFERENTIAL_ITEM (Pilot items are structurally analogous but byte/content distinct from BAT-01..BAT-16; pilot responses are NEVER reused as main inferential data).
governing_laws.optimization_prohibition: PILOT_CALIBRATION != TREATMENT_OPTIMIZATION (Pilot outcomes may determine GO/HOLD for assay, but pilot results may NEVER be used to retune K1, K2, or K3 selectively).

preregistered_criteria.anti_floor_rule: Baseline K0 must achieve > 0% accuracy across the 5 pilot items to ensure instructions and tasks are parseable.
preregistered_criteria.anti_ceiling_rule: No single treatment arm (K0, K0D, K1, K2, K3) may achieve 100% accuracy on all 5 pilot items, preventing saturation/ceiling effects.
preregistered_criteria.discriminative_range: Target overall accuracy across arms should span between 20% and 80%, ensuring sufficient dynamic range to evaluate differential methodology effects.
preregistered_criteria.cluster_variance_requirement: At least 3 of the 5 pilot construct families must exhibit non-zero variance across arms.

consequence_of_gate_failure.floor_failure: If K0 = 0% and K1/K2/K3 = 0%, items are defectively ambiguous or unparseable. PILOT_RESULT = HOLD. Fresh sacrificial pilot fixtures must be preregistered in a new Freeze version.
consequence_of_gate_failure.ceiling_failure: If K1 = 100% and K2 = 100%, battery is classified as NON_IDENTIFYING_CEILING. Harder adversarial items must be introduced under a new Freeze version.
consequence_of_gate_failure.treatment_ambiguity: If treatment-language ambiguity is discovered during pilot, PILOT_RESULT = HOLD. Any rewrite requires explicit justification, versioned packets for all arms, and fresh sacrificial pilot contexts.
